# ethereum-optimism/op-geth Daily Update (Mar 2, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today, development focused on code refactoring within the `eth/downloader` module, specifically improving test structure. A new pull request was opened to address transaction handling during reorgs. An issue regarding flashblocks support was closed due to the deprecation of `op-geth`.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Test Refactoring
*   Refactored `receiptreference_test.go` to use sub-tests and pass `local testing.T` instead of a global context, improving test isolation and reliability ([#771](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/771)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   A new pull request, [#772](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/772), was opened to address the dropping of interop transactions on reorgs within the `txpool`.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Flashblocks Support Deprecation
*   The issue concerning Flashblocks support within Geth ([#756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/756)) was closed. This decision was made due to the deprecation of `op-geth`, rendering further development in this area unnecessary.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were opened today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Kona Protocol Discrepancies and Vulnerabilities
*   **Kona and op-node can disagree on brotli channels** ([#19333](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19333)): A developer has volunteered to work on this issue, which describes two distinct bugs causing divergence between Kona and op-node for brotli-compressed channels.
*   **Unknown batch type panics and causes denial of service in kona-protocol** ([#19334](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19334)): A developer has offered to address this bug, where the `kona-protocol` batch decoder panics on unknown batch types, leading to potential denial of service.
*   **Kona frame parsing mismatch against op-node and OP Stack Specs** ([#19335](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19335)): A developer has expressed interest in working on this issue, which highlights a discrepancy in Kona's frame parsing compared to `op-node` and OP Stack specifications.
*   **kona: orphaned sources/variant.rs in kona-derive references non-existent AsyncIterator and stale API** ([#19340](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19340)): A developer offered to fix this issue, but it was noted that a pull request already exists to address the orphaned code and stale API references.
*   **[L2CM] Add ProxyAdminOwnedBase access control to predeploy initialize() functions** ([#19313](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/19313)): A suggestion was made to use an existing PR for L1 contracts as a guide for implementing the required access control.
